card.name: Naltrexone dosing text before numbers
card.fires_on: Spaces and small linking words (of, for, treat) just before a number or condition in naltrexone label text about alcohol or opioid dependence. Strongest on the space before a dose or duration such as 50 mg or 12 weeks.

modes.label: Space before dose or duration
modes.description: The blank space token right before a number like 50 mg, 12 weeks or 7 to 10 days in naltrexone dosing sentences.
